title: National rheumatology database of the German Rheumatism Research Centre and the Regional Cooperative Rheumatism Centres in the German Society for Rheumatology
summary:
The National Database has been carried out in rheumatology centres in Germany since 1993. It serves to describe rheumatological care and the health situation of people affected by rheumatism. The impact of the disease on everyday life and working life is examined.
 
The study also serves to illustrate the quality of care for people with inflammatory rheumatic diseases in Germany. For example, it looks at how long it took to get an appointment with a rheumatologist, how many people receive innovative medications such as biologics, and how many people are affected by pain or severe fatigue.
conditions: Juvenile arthritis in diseases classified elsewhere

interventions.name:
Persons with a physician reported diagnosis of an inflammatory rheumatic disease
Data is collected once a year as part of the rheumatology consultation. Physician reported items:
- Diagnosis and diagnostic certainty, onset of symptoms
- Comorbidities
- COVID-19

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-Signed declaration of consent
-(Suspected) inflammatory rheumatic disease
-Sufficient German language skills to complete the questionnaire
Exclusion criteria:
Insufficient knowledge of German
No consent to participate in the study
